prompt: A high, locked, grainy night-mode view from the rafters above a rented attic's narrow door, looking down at Brandon on the floor frozen halfway through a crunch, rigid, brows raised, eyelids wide, mouth shut tight, eyes aimed at the door. His laptop on the floor beside him throws a pale rectangle of light up his arm. A strip of landing light glows under the door and two dark shoe shapes interrupt it. The frame is washed out and hazy, the door wood is chipped and painted over several times, and a clothes rail sags beside it. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
